release_notes: MBT POS v3.0.86: Shop-floor access + honest UI. Cashiers can Add Product, edit info, and Receive Stock (Inventory tab on upgrade). Cost/margin hidden for cashiers. Category Visuals, product delete, Adjust Stock, and inventory export stay Manager+/Super-Admin with clear locked-button reasons. Manager Settings is view-only without Save. Debt write-off and backdating remain Super-Admin PIN gated even if tabs are granted. Users & Access explains tab vs vault.
